title: File:Gaoligongshan IMGP5778.jpeg
claims: A Gaoligong mountain ridge seen through broken cloud: steep forested slopes, a pale road cut on the left flank, scrub in the foreground and cloud wrapping the higher ground; the exact section is not recorded by Commons. It is a location photograph, not a 2026 race-day photograph, and it does not show a start arch, finish gantry, bib, timing mat, aid table, course marking or race crowd.

Commons titles the file Gaoligongshan IMGP5778.jpeg. The route page uses it as Gaoligong mountain context for the MGU 168; because the exact section is unknown, it is not presented as the 2026 course, a checkpoint or a race-day view.

The Commons author field reads Knautzen; the file is marked CC-BY-2.0-DE (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/de/); the relevant date is 2006-10 (month only in the Commons date field); the file page gives no camera coordinates; the original is 1,024 × 768 px; 472,137 bytes.

The route page uses a 960 × 720 px; 155,199 bytes copy without cropping or colour change and credits Knautzen, CC-BY-2.0-DE (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/de/), Wikimedia Commons; the resized copy keeps the same licence.
